title: Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
abstract: arXiv:2611.24936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Jailbreak attempts and harmful prompts remain a challenge for the safe deployment of large language models. We study whether contrastively learned representations can support safety detection without training an additional downstream classifier. We propose Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference (JDPI), which uses binary safety labels to construct harmful and benign prototypes and makes predictions from relative prototype distances. JDPI uses only binary safety labels for encoder adaptation, prototype construction, and validation. In our setup, it uses fewer labeled examples than the classifier baseline (Method A) by avoiding the separate split used to train the downstream classifier. Across four benchmarks covering different input formats, contrastive fine-tuning improves JDPI's detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points. translated_title: 基于对比原型结构的大语言模型越狱检测
translated_abstract: 越狱攻击与有害提示仍然是大语言模型安全部署面临的挑战。我们研究了对比学习所获得的表示能否在无需训练额外下游分类器的情况下支持安全检测。我们提出了基于原型推理的越狱检测方法（Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference, JDPI），该方法利用二元安全标签构建有害原型与良性原型，并通过相对原型距离进行预测。JDPI 在编码器适配、原型构建和验证中仅使用二元安全标签。在我们的实验设置中，由于避免了用于训练下游分类器的单独数据划分，JDPI 相比分类器基线（方法 A）所需的标注样本更少。在涵盖不同输入格式的四个基准测试中，对比微调使 JDPI 的检测准确率提升了 9.1 至 18.0 个百分点。在使用相同编码器的情况下，JDPI 在其中一个基准上取得了略高的 ROC-AUC，并与（原文此处截断）的差距保持在 0.017 以内。
tldr: 提出JDPI方法，利用对比学习构建有害与良性原型，仅凭二元安全标签通过相对原型距离实现大语言模型越狱检测，无需训练额外下游分类器，在四个基准上将检测准确率提升9.1-18.0个百分点。
en_tdlr: JDPI detects LLM jailbreaks by contrastively learning to build harmful and benign prototypes, using only binary safety labels and relative prototype distances without training an additional downstream classifier, improving detection accuracy by 9.1-18.0 percentage points across four benchmarks.
